verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native sync of invoices, payments, or revenue-recognition entries to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any other general ledger or ERP. The integrations it does document are adjacent and earn no credit: Stripe invoice creation for payment collection, cloud marketplace invoicing, and data-warehouse export. The revenue-recognition page says only that Metronome stores the raw data, not that it posts entries to a ledger.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
